resolutionNote: flex-direction itself can't be CSS-transitioned, so this crossfades through the reflow instead: fade+shrink slightly, swap orientation while barely visible, fade back in. Also gave the position nudge (from the earlier center-pivot fix) a real transition instead of an instant jump. Fixed by a direct commit (not a PR) while working in this exact area for an unrelated request; PR #94 (and duplicates #96/#97/#98 already closed against it) proposed the same fix independently and is being closed as a duplicate of this commit.
